http_429_policy: Stop the active batch; no retry loop
scope_contract: Broad discovery metadata is kept separate from substantive Case 03–Casanare inclusion decisions. This crawler fetches no transcripts or media.
snapshot_selection_rule: Prefer an exhausted, count-reconciled include-unavailable view. Preserve the default-visible snapshot under alternate_snapshot_views; its earlier discrepancy remains historical evidence, not an unresolved selected-view gap. Videos and Live now use the timestamped fresh exhausted receipt chains. Earlier appearances absent from those chains are retained under the same collection ID with is_current=false; no additional collection is created.

count_definitions.returned_memberships: Returned list positions, including unavailable placeholders and repeated appearances
count_definitions.visible_memberships: Legacy alias of returned_memberships; NOT playable video count
count_definitions.normal_title_memberships: Returned positions with a nonempty public title, excluding known unavailable placeholders; playability not implied
count_definitions.unique_video_ids: At collection level: distinct IDs in its selected snapshot. At manifest level: distinct IDs across all retained current and historical memberships.
count_definitions.hidden_unavailable_count: Numeric hidden count explicitly stated by the selected view; placeholders returned by Show unavailable are counted separately
count_definitions.unavailable_placeholder_memberships: Returned blank-title placeholder positions revealed by the normal unavailable-item action
count_definitions.count_reconciled: Declared count equals returned positions plus any explicitly numbered entries still hidden
count_definitions.pagination_exhausted: No actual primary-list continuation remains, with no crawl error or cycle; does not establish complete historical availability
count_definitions.membership_count: All retained membership rows, including explicitly historical appearances; current_membership_count + historical_membership_count.
count_definitions.current_membership_count: Membership rows in the selected snapshot for each collection. is_current defaults to true on unchanged baseline playlist/Shorts/web rows; per-source timestamps govern recency.
count_definitions.historical_membership_count: Retained prior appearances with is_current=false and membership_status=historical_not_in_latest_listing. Not added to selected collection returned_memberships.
count_definitions.current_unique_video_ids: Distinct IDs with at least one is_current=true (or unchanged legacy) membership in a selected source snapshot.
count_definitions.historical_only_unique_video_ids: Retained discovery IDs without any current selected-snapshot membership. Not a deletion, availability or scope determination.
count_definitions.retained_memberships: For refreshed channel collections: selected returned_memberships plus retained historical_memberships.
count_definitions.membership_status: current_selected_snapshot or historical_not_in_latest_listing on refreshed channel rows/nodes; unchanged legacy rows imply current for their selected baseline snapshot.
